derived.method: 231,924,793 Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units (February 20, 2026) / (748,688,068 shares of common stock outstanding + 445,586,312 participating Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units, both at December 31, 2025) = 19.42%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Basis: Blackstone Inc. common stock plus the partnership units of Blackstone Holdings held by its limited partners (Blackstone personnel and others), which are exchangeable for common stock one-for-one and share in distributions; together these are the whole economic interest in Blackstone Holdings. The FY2025 10-K gives no unit count at the Item 12 date, so the December 31, 2025 dividend-eligibility table is used; the 10-K's own 52.2% of class for his units implies about 444 million units, consistent with it. Adding the 34,494,942 unvested participating common shares to the denominator (total 1,228,769,322) would give about 18.9%.

Blackstone files no DEF 14A; ownership is from Item 12 of the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001193125-26-082531, filed February 27, 2026), as of February 20, 2026. Mr. Schwarzman is Co-Founder, Chairman and CEO. BASIS: he owns no Blackstone Inc. common stock, so his share of the listed common stock alone is 0%. His economic interest is in Blackstone Holdings partnership units, which share in Blackstone's earnings alongside the common stock and can be exchanged for it one-for-one. The record therefore uses a derived figure of 19.42% of common stock plus limited partners' participating units (see derived.method; about 18.9% if unvested participating common stock is added). The units he holds include 3,686,266 units in trusts for which he is investment trustee (beneficial ownership disclaimed) and 12,368,074 vested units held back under minimum retained ownership requirements. pctVoting is null because the filing gives no personal voting percentage: the 37.5% Series I vote belongs to Blackstone Partners L.L.C., which he controls, and the Series II holder's majority vote for directors belongs to Blackstone Group Management L.L.C. HOLDERS: Vanguard (8.5%) and BlackRock (6.2%), from 2024 Schedule 13G filings, are measured as % of common stock only, so they are recorded with basis 'class' and never used to compute everyone else. Jonathan D. Gray holds 41,293,901 units (9.3% of units) and 2,270,041 shares. DIVIDENDS: $3,635.7m of capital distributions to Blackstone Inc. common stockholders in 2025, from the equity statement. The cash-flow line 'Dividends/Distributions to Stockholders and Unitholders' is $6,013.4m and also includes distributions to Blackstone Holdings unitholders, which are non-controlling interests ($2,394.1m in the equity statement), so it is not used; on the derived ownership basis, which includes the units, about $6.01 billion went to stockholders and unitholders together. BUYBACKS: $122.6m of common stock repurchases (0.8 million shares). STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back for equity-based compensation. PLAN: null; no broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K. GEOGRAPHY: null because the segment note gives only percentages of total GAAP revenues by region, attributed by the geography of investments held: Americas 80%, Europe, Middle East and Africa 13%, Asia-Pacific 7% (2025); domestically generated revenues were 68% of total GAAP revenues.
